label: sch_entrance01_boy_01
text: There’re more books than I can read in a lifetime.\nBoy, am I ever glad I came to this school!

label: sch_entrance01_girl_01
text: I feel like I can grow stronger if I sign up for\nbattle studies!

label: sch_entrance01_girl_07
text: You know, you can get a lot of battle tips from\nMs. Tyme’s math class too.

label: sch_entrance01_boy_09
text: I really like language class! It doesn’t have too\nmuch to do with Pokémon, though...

label: sch_entrance01_girl_02
text: Occulture is such a weird magazine! It’s just full\nof utter nonsense!

label: sch_entrance01_girl_03
text: Don’t think I’ve ever seen a school where the\nentrance was also the library!

label: sch_entrance01_boy_03
text: I’m pretty good at Pokémon battles but I have\ntrouble studying...\c\nThink you can help me prep for our next exam?

label: sch_entrance01_boy_04
text: I’m really good at my studies, but Pokémon\nbattles are another story...\c\nDo you think you can help me become stronger?

label: sch_entrance01_girl_04
text: There’s a book about the Herba Mystica—I know\nthere is—but where could it be...?

label: sch_entrance01_man_01
text: Hey, did you know that this school was\nestablished 805 years ago?

label: sch_entrance01_boy_05
text: Isn’t it impressive? Everyone here is here to study!

label: sch_entrance01_boy_06
text: Are you going for the STEM track? Or maybe\nthe humanities track? If you’re into Pokémon,\r\nthen the general studies track might be good?

label: sch_entrance01_man_02
text: I’m from a small town called Alfornada! There’s\nso many people here at the school!

label: sch_entrance01_girl_05
text: I heard it’s easier to find where I’m going if I look\nit up on the computer. Is that true?

label: sch_entrance01_boy_07
text: These Pachirisu are helping me get books I\ncan’t reach!

label: sch_entrance01_boy_10
text: There’s this girl named Penny in the STEM track.\nShe’s smart and really good with machines.\c\nI heard she’s started coming to school again.

label: sch_entrance01_girl_08
text: Reading out loud from your textbook gets your\nears and mouth in on the learning!

label: sch_entrance01_girl_09
text: I joined the school because I wanted to learn\nabout Pokémon, but now I’m getting interested\r\nin the STEM track too!

label: sch_entrance01_boy_11
text: Bug types eat grass—that’s why they’re strong\nagainst Grass types!

label: sch_entrance01_boy_12
text: I asked so many questions that the teacher\nlearned my name on the first day!

label: sch_entrance01_woman_03
text: So between a Super Potion and a Hyper Potion,\nwhich one heals your Pokémon more?

label: sch_entrance01_woman_04
text: Have you heard of Team Star? They were a big\nproblem around here—but that was a while ago.

label: sch_entrance01_man_03
text: I’m telling you—I’m not a teacher, I’m a student!\nI’m wearing the uniform, aren’t I?!

label: sch_entrance01_man_06
text: Steel-type moves are super effective against\nFairy-type Pokémon... Did I get that right?

label: sch_entrance01_man_07
text: It’s so hard to figure out the type matchups of\nPokémon with two types...

label: sch_entrance01_woman_02
text: It’s great that night classes are available here.\nI can work during the day and still learn!

label: sch_entrance01_woman_05
text: I stay up late at night because it seems like a\nwaste to let the day end early...but then I regret\r\nit the next morning.

label: sch_entrance01_woman_06
text: I saw a Pokémon drop a coin. I kept the coin so\nI could give it back, but the Pokémon was so tiny\r\nthat I haven’t been able to find it since.

label: sch_entrance01_boy_08
text: They say there are some Pokémon that’ll evolve\nif you have them walk with you for a long time.

label: sch_entrance01_girl_06
text:
The school is so mysterious at night! You meet
completely different people than during the day!\c
Did you know that outside towns, different
Pokémon come out at night too?

label: sch_entrance01_man_04
text: It’s an honor to be able to study here at the\nalma mater of a famous professor.

label: sch_entrance01_man_05
text: This kid Arven in my class seems like he’s been\nhaving a rough time since, like, last year. I know\r\nhow hard it must be for him.
